title: Distance between linear Boolean forms
statement: For any $a,b\\in\\mathbb F_2^n$, the relative Hamming distance between the functions $x\\mapsto a\\cdot x$ and $x\\mapsto b\\cdot x$ on $\\mathbb F_2^n$ is $0$ if $a=b$, and is $1/2$ otherwise.
